# Euronews
> Pan-European multilingual news publisher covering breaking news, European affairs, world events, business, culture, travel, and video journalism.

Euronews publishes international reporting and explainers across multiple language editions, with strong coverage of EU institutions, geopolitics, business, science, travel, and no-comment video. Its site combines continuously updated news pages, topic hubs, programmes, and verticals such as Business, Green, Culture, Travel, and Next.

## Main News
- [Homepage](https://www.euronews.com/): Main English homepage with top stories, live updates, featured videos, and major international coverage.
- [News](https://www.euronews.com/news): Central news index for latest reporting across Europe, world, politics, and current affairs.
- [Europe](https://www.euronews.com/europe): Coverage of European politics, societies, institutions, elections, and regional developments.
- [World](https://www.euronews.com/world): International news covering conflicts, diplomacy, disasters, and major global events.
- [My Europe](https://www.euronews.com/my-europe): Reporting focused on EU institutions, policy, legislation, and European integration.
- [Latest News](https://www.euronews.com/latest-news): Reverse-chronological feed of the newest published Euronews stories and updates.

## Video & Programmes
- [Video](https://www.euronews.com/video): Video hub with reports, interviews, explainers, and short-form news clips.
- [Live](https://www.euronews.com/live): Live stream access for Euronews television coverage and rolling news programming.
- [No Comment](https://www.euronews.com/nocomment): Video reports without narration, focused on raw footage from news events worldwide.
- [Europeans](https://www.euronews.com/programs/europeans): Programme covering European stories, personalities, and issues from across the continent.
- [Brussels, My Love?](https://www.euronews.com/programs/brussels-my-love): Debate programme analysing EU politics, institutions, and major European policy questions.
- [State of the Union](https://www.euronews.com/programs/state-of-the-union): Weekly programme summarising key European political and economic developments.
- [Focus](https://www.euronews.com/programs/focus): In-depth reporting and analysis on major international stories and trends.

## Business
- [Business](https://www.euronews.com/business): Business news hub covering markets, companies, technology, and the European economy.
- [Markets](https://www.euronews.com/business/markets): Coverage of stock markets, investing, inflation, and financial developments.
- [Economy](https://www.euronews.com/business/economy): Reporting on macroeconomics, growth, jobs, trade, and public finances.
- [Money](https://www.euronews.com/business/money): Personal finance and consumer-focused stories on spending, savings, and costs.
- [Tech](https://www.euronews.com/business/tech): Technology business coverage including AI, platforms, startups, and digital regulation.
- [Real Estate](https://www.euronews.com/business/real-estate): Property market reporting on housing, rents, development, and affordability.
- [Work](https://www.euronews.com/business/work): Workplace and labour coverage including employment, careers, and work trends.

## Green
- [Green](https://www.euronews.com/green): Climate and environment vertical covering sustainability, biodiversity, and energy transition.
- [Climate](https://www.euronews.com/green/climate): Reporting on climate science, emissions, extreme weather, and climate policy.
- [Energy](https://www.euronews.com/green/energy): Coverage of renewables, fossil fuels, power markets, and energy security.
- [Mobility](https://www.euronews.com/green/mobility): Sustainable transport news on EVs, rail, aviation, and urban mobility.
- [Living](https://www.euronews.com/green/living): Consumer and lifestyle stories focused on greener everyday choices.
- [Circular Economy](https://www.euronews.com/green/circular-economy): Reporting on recycling, waste reduction, reuse, and sustainable production.

## Culture
- [Culture](https://www.euronews.com/culture): Arts and culture coverage spanning film, music, books, design, and heritage.
- [Film](https://www.euronews.com/culture/film): News, interviews, and festival coverage from cinema and streaming.
- [Music](https://www.euronews.com/culture/music): Reporting on artists, releases, performances, and music industry developments.
- [Books](https://www.euronews.com/culture/books): Coverage of publishing, authors, literary trends, and notable releases.
- [Art](https://www.euronews.com/culture/art): Stories on exhibitions, museums, artists, and the art market.
- [Living](https://www.euronews.com/culture/living): Lifestyle and cultural trend reporting across Europe and beyond.

## Travel
- [Travel](https://www.euronews.com/travel): Travel vertical with destination guides, transport updates, and tourism trends.
- [Destinations](https://www.euronews.com/travel/destinations): Place-focused travel stories and destination inspiration from Europe and worldwide.
- [Aviation](https://www.euronews.com/travel/aviation): Airline, airport, and aviation industry news relevant to travellers.
- [Transport](https://www.euronews.com/travel/transport): Rail, road, ferry, and broader transport updates affecting travel planning.
- [Food and Drink](https://www.euronews.com/travel/food-and-drink): Culinary travel stories, regional food culture, and drink-focused features.
- [Adventure](https://www.euronews.com/travel/adventure): Outdoor and activity-based travel ideas, from hiking to nature experiences.

## Next
- [Next](https://www.euronews.com/next): Innovation and future-focused reporting on science, health, and emerging technology.
- [Science](https://www.euronews.com/next/science): Coverage of scientific discoveries, research, space, and health-related breakthroughs.
- [Health](https://www.euronews.com/next/health): Public health, medicine, wellness, and healthcare system reporting.
- [Digital](https://www.euronews.com/next/digital): Stories on internet culture, platforms, cybersecurity, and digital life.
- [Innovation](https://www.euronews.com/next/innovation): Reporting on startups, inventions, and technological change shaping society.

## Topic Hubs
- [Ukraine](https://www.euronews.com/tag/ukraine): Topic page aggregating Euronews coverage related to Ukraine and the war.
- [European Union](https://www.euronews.com/tag/european-union): Topic hub for EU institutions, policy, summits, and legislation.
- [NATO](https://www.euronews.com/tag/nato): Aggregated reporting on NATO strategy, summits, defence, and security issues.
- [Russia](https://www.euronews.com/tag/russia): Topic page for stories involving Russia, its politics, and foreign policy.
- [Climate Change](https://www.euronews.com/tag/climate-change): Collection of climate-related reporting, analysis, and environmental developments.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.euronews.com/tag/artificial-intelligence): Topic hub for AI policy, products, ethics, and business developments.

## Language Editions
- [English](https://www.euronews.com/): English-language edition with global and European news coverage.
- [Français](https://fr.euronews.com/): French-language edition of Euronews news, video, and feature coverage.
- [Deutsch](https://de.euronews.com/): German-language edition covering European and international current affairs.
- [Español](https://es.euronews.com/): Spanish-language edition with news, video, and topic pages.
- [Italiano](https://it.euronews.com/): Italian-language edition focused on European and world reporting.
- [Português](https://pt.euronews.com/): Portuguese-language edition of Euronews journalism and video.
- [Türkçe](https://tr.euronews.com/): Turkish-language edition with breaking news and regional coverage.
- [العربية](https://arabic.euronews.com/): Arabic-language edition covering international and regional developments.
